tileFailure.coverageTitle: No map tiles at this zoom
tileFailure.coverageDesc: <1>tiles.pzmap.org</1> is reachable but hasn't rendered this area at this detail level. Zoom out, or try Refresh later.
tileFailure.networkDesc: This tile couldn't be loaded from the panel. Check the panel's own network connection and try <1>Refresh</1>.
tileFailure.gzipDesc: This tile's data reached the browser still gzip-compressed instead of being decompressed automatically. This usually means a reverse proxy in front of the panel (nginx, Apache, Caddy, etc.) is stripping or mishandling the Content-Encoding header. If that matches your setup, ask whoever manages the proxy to check that setting.
tileFailure.htmlTitle: An HTML page arrived instead of a map tile
tileFailure.htmlDesc: Something in front of the panel returned an HTML page instead of the tile image -- often a proxy error page, a login page, or a network sign-in portal intercepting the request. Check whatever sits in front of the panel (a reverse proxy, VPN, or captive network) for something intercepting this request.
tileFailure.jsonTitle: The panel returned an error instead of a map tile
tileFailure.jsonDesc: The response was a JSON error message rather than image data. This points to a problem on the panel's own side rather than the network in between.
tileFailure.pngTitle: A PNG image arrived where a JPEG was expected
tileFailure.pngDesc: This tile's data is a real image, just not in the format the panel expected. This points to a mismatch on the panel's own side, not the network in between.
tileFailure.emptyDesc: No data came back for this tile at all. This usually points to a network or proxy issue rather than a problem with the map itself.
tileFailure.truncatedTitle: Map tile was cut short in transit
tileFailure.truncatedDesc: This tile's image data is genuine, but only {{received}} of {{expected}} bytes arrived. The connection was cut short in transit, which usually points to a proxy or network issue rather than a problem with the map.
tileFailure.corruptDesc: This tile's data is genuine image data that arrived complete but couldn't be decoded. This may be a one-off glitch -- try Refresh.
tileFailure.unrecognizedTitle: Map tile arrived as unrecognized data
tileFailure.unrecognizedDesc: This tile's data doesn't match any known format the panel recognizes. Raw bytes: {{hex}}
